translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Thotolo yi Yesu
Ku nzimunina, Pheve Yinlongo yinata Yesu ku dikanga muingi Satana
kantota.
Bu kafua nzala, mu diambu di lusambulu
mu tezo ki makumaya ma bilumbu, muini ayi builu ; buna wumona nzala.
Mbadi mvukumuni wuyiza va kaba ayi wunkamba : —Enati widi Muana Nzambi buna kamba matadi mama makituka mapha.
Vayi Yesu wumvutudila : —Disonama ti :

content.text: mutu kalendi zingilanga kaka mu dipha ko
vayi mu mambu moso mantotukanga mu munu wu Nzambi.

content: Buna Satana wunnata ku divula dinlongo, wuntula ku mbata muanzu wu Nzo Nzambi ;
ayi wunkamba : “Enati bukiedika widi Muana Nzambi wukilozi ku ntoto, bila disonama :

content.text: Nzambi wela fidisa zimbasi ziandi mu diambu diaku
ayi ziela kunata mu mioko miawu
mu diambu kulu kuaku kuedi bumina thutu mu ditadi !”

content: Yesu wumvutudila : —Disonama diaka ti :
Satana wunnata diaka va mbata mongo wunda, kuna kammonisina bipfumu bioso bidi va nza ayi minkembo miawu.
Bosi wunkamba : —Tala, ngeyo kumfukimina kuandi ayi kumbuongimina ; ndieka kuvana bima bioso biabi !
Yesu wunkamba : —Botuka, Satana ! Bila disonama ti :

content.text: “Pfumu Nzambi aku niandi fueti buongimina ayi niandi kaka fueti sadila !”

content: Buna satana wumbika. Bosi zimbasi ziyiza va kaba ayi zinsadila.
Yesu wutona longa
Yesu bu kawa ti bakotisa Yowani mu nloko ; buna wuvutuka ku Ngalili.
Wubotuka ku Ngalili. Wuyenda vuanda ku Kafalinawumi, divula didi mu ndambu mbu ; mu tsi yi Zabuloni ayi Nefatali
muingi mambu ma mbikudi Ezayi madedakana :

content.text: Tsi yi Zabuloni ayi yi Nefatali,
tsi yidi mu ndambu mbu ku disimu di Yolidani ayi ku Ngalili
Batu baba nzingilanga mu tombi bamona kiezila kingolo ;
kiezila kitotukila batu bobo baba nkalanga mu tsi yiba

content: Tona thangu yina, Yesu wutona longa bu katuba : —Lubalula mavanga bila Kipfumu ki diyilu kifikimini !
Minlonguki mitheti mi Yesu
Yesu bu kaba kuenda yendanga muna muyenda mbu wu Ngalili, wumona bakhomba buadi ; Simoni diodi baba ntedilanga Piela ayi khombꞌandi Andela balembo lozi dikondi mu mbu bila baba banlobi mbizi.
Buna wuba kamba : —Ndandakananu ayi ndiela kulukitula minlobi mi batu.
Muna thangu beni kaka, basia bika makondi mawu ayi banlandakana.
Buela kuesa fioti, wumona diaka bakhomba buadi : Zaki muana Zebede ayi khombꞌandi Yowani, balembo londi makondi mawu mu khati nlungu va kimosi ayi dise diawu Zebede. Mamvawu wuba tela.
Muna yawu thangu mamvawu babika nlungu awu ayi dise diawu, banlandakana.
Yesu wubelusa bambevo
Yesu wudiata mu Ngalili dioso ayi wuba longanga mu zinzo ziawu zi lukutukunu, wuba longanga Nsamu Wumboti wu Kipfumu. Wubelusa ziphila zioso zi bimbevo ayi ziphasi zioso zi phila mu phila mu batu.

Zitsangu ziandi zimana tembakana mu tsi yoso yi Sili ayi bannatina batu boso baba bimbevo ; bobo bamona ziphasi zi phila mu phila ; ayi yamusu ku phila mu phila, bobo baba ziphevi zimbimbi, bobo baba kimbevo kisisuka ayi bobo baba kimbevo kivonga mianzi. Yesu wumana babelusa.
Nkangu wu batu bawombo baba kuenda nlandakananga : baba mu Ngalili, baba mu Dekapoli
, baba mu Yelusalemi, baba mu Yuda dioso ayi baba ku disimu di Yolidani.
